title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (June 2026)
summary: This is a Hacker News 'Ask HN' community discussion thread where users share what projects and ideas they're currently working on. It serves as a monthly tradition for the HN community to exchange updates, get feedback, and discover what others in the tech space are building. The thread received significant engagement with 276 points and 979 comments.
problem_solved: Facilitates community connection and knowledge sharing among developers and tech enthusiasts by providing a platform to discuss ongoing projects
why_valuable: Offers valuable insights into current trends, emerging projects, and collaborative opportunities within the tech community
